tables.heading: Throttle limits
tables.header_text: | Resource | Default quota | Can be increased |

rows.text: | Account access API | The account access API has a collective throttle limit of 20 transactions per second (TPS). For read APIs, you can open a support case to request a limit increase. The write API operations have a limit of 15 outstanding asynchronous calls. This limit cannot be increased. | Yes |

cells.Default quota: The account access API has a collective throttle limit of 20 transactions per second (TPS). For read APIs, you can open a support case to request a limit increase. The write API operations have a limit of 15 outstanding asynchronous calls. This limit cannot be increased.
